title: TeNo
tagline: This is a website version for the TeNo side-panel extension, designed to extend the browser workflow with advanced management features...
description: This is a website version for the TeNo side-panel extension, designed to extend the browser workflow with advanced management features for links, reminders, cart items, and timers. It provides a structured, keyboard-friendly interface for editing, organizing, labeling, and accessing saved content more efficiently.
features: Dual Theme System - Learn about the Minimalist vs Modern styling architecture.
Collaboration & Sharing - Discover the unified label architecture and role-based access control (RBAC).
Core Modules - Understand the primary functional tabs: Links, Cart, Reminders, Timer, and Prompts.
Settings & Compliance - Details on data export (GDPR/DPDP) and server-side account deletion.
